prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one PORTRAIT 1000x1550 comic page ROUGH THUMBNAIL, loose pencil/ink with muted flat color and vintage grain, NOT polished finished art. Five panels precisely as described, thin black borders, cream gutters. No lettering, no speech balloons, no labels, no sound effects; all lettering will be typeset separately. Reserve upper parts specified as uncluttered pale background, put faces/action below those reserves. Reference 1 establishes likeness/costumes ONLY, not cover composition: Tony taller lean strong dark messy hair navy work shirt green trousers red backpack jetter switched OFF; Sean shorter compact strong muscular, bald gray chin goatee orange work shirt blue overalls, long physically straight wooden plunger red cup and service kit. Normal adult proportions. Sean is a useful novice, Tony relaxed caring teacher; equally capable. White boot covers from second panel onward. Hotel wedding elegance. Manager swept brown hair thin mustache black suit burgundy tie. No water blast. PAGE ONE. Panel2: entrance mat both seated/crouched fitting white boot covers, tools safely set down; Sean left looking at guests right; keep top110px clear. Panel3: Tony fitting second white boot cover, Sean listening, Tony centered left Sean right; reserve top160px whole width for two linked balloons, figures lower150px.
